title: The History of Chemistry, Volume II
lineage: The inspected work is Thomson’s 1831 retrospective account. He says he reproduces a journal of 26 August 1804, but the journal itself was not independently inspected. His stated reaction follows the reproduced material and is a later recollection.

passages.note: Printed pp. 289–292 / source PDF pp. 299–302: Thomson’s account of the August 1804 discussion, its stated journal text and his recollected immediate evaluation.

file.method: Selected pages extracted from the complete scan; every mapped source and excerpt page was raster-compared at 50 dpi.
